standfirst: The insect nodaviruses — Flock House, Black beetle, Boolarra, Nodamura, Pariacoto and Newington virus. Two RNA segments, six declared proteins, and the one feature that separates this module from every other nodavirus module: the capsid precursor cleaves itself. Alpha assembles into provirions and then cuts between Asn and Ala, releasing mature beta and the 44-residue gamma peptide (PMID 1404613, PMID 9765417).

modules.Alphanodavirus: Six features on two segments. RNA1 carries protein A and, from subgenomic RNA3, B1 (in frame with A) and B2 (+1 frame). RNA2 carries alpha and its two cleavage products. The collections are small because the genus has 31 genomes in BV-BRC, and three of the six features were expanded by extraction from the genomes rather than from deposits.

gaps: Two proteins are deliberately absent. The Pariacoto minor capsid protein is real — a virion protein initiated at the second AUG of the capsid ORF (PMID 13679619) — but it is alpha minus 24 N-terminal residues and therefore 100% identical to alpha across its whole length, so no profile can separate the two. The BBV RNA2 second ORF (“URF”, 72 aa) is a 1984 computational prediction with no product reported since and one deposit family-wide.
derived: Beta and gamma are a coordinate operation on alpha, not collections of their own — nothing in BV-BRC is annotated as mature beta. The cut was placed by chemistry on each genome's own precursor rather than at FHV's residue number, because alpha runs 395–407 aa across the genus. Scanning for Asn followed by Ala or Ser with 38–52 residues remaining finds exactly one site in every species and two in none, and it reproduces FHV's published Asn363‖Ala364 without being given it. Pariacoto came out of the same scan as the documented Asn‖Ser exception at gamma 40.

why.B1: 4 members from three species. B1's start codon is published for FHV/BBV (GenBank) and Nodamura (protein A residue 908, PMID 15163762) and for nobody else; 8 of 13 candidate genomes were rejected because the aligned start position is not a Met. A thin collection of correct starts beats a full one of invented ones.
why.B2: 12 members in two length classes, 90–106 aa and 137–143 aa. That is the documented biology, not a mixed bin: PMID 15163762 gives FHV 106 and Nodamura 134 and 137 in one sentence, and the two Nodamura forms come from the first and second AUG of subgenomic RNA3 (PMID 12573589).
